diagnosis.overview: The worker frequently fails to reliably read source data from input files, hallucinating values or getting stuck in repeat read‑loops (e.g., identical 'event_type="BUSINESS"' across many rows, and tasks that produced no deliverable after many retrying file reads), and when it does produce output it often writes Excel formula strings instead of Python‑computed values, leaving cells empty.
diagnosis.root_cause: The worker frequently fails to reliably read source data from input files, hallucinating values or getting stuck in repeat read‑loops (e.g., identical 'event_type="BUSINESS"' across many rows, and tasks that produced no deliverable after many retrying file reads), and when it does produce output it often writes Excel formula strings instead of Python‑computed values, leaving cells empty.
diagnosis.general_mechanism: 1. Prompt rule: Before any processing, read the entire source file using the dedicated file‑reading tool, verify that the returned data is non‑empty and matches the expected structure; if reading fails, stop and report the error instead of guessing or re‑attempting endlessly. 2. Tool binding: ensure the Excel reading tool (openpyxl / equivalent) is correctly bound, resolves file paths, and includes a short retry with an exit condition to prevent infinite read‑loops. 3. Prompt rule: never write formula strings (e.g., `=…`) to cells; always compute the required result in Python and write the raw value. 4. Formatting rule: strictly match the target output range dimensions, shape, and placement; when deduplicating, modify the sheet in place and do not add extra headers or content outside the specified cells.
